name: FluidDial-CYD (Factory Reset — wipes everything)
_note: Paths are pinned to a COMMIT, not the vX.Y.Z tag. jsDelivr caches tag->commit resolution permanently, so a tag that has ever been served cannot be repointed — see CHANGELOG v2.1.9. A commit SHA is a fresh, immutable URL and is therefore the only way to correct an already-published release in place.
